mapper.select: SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.name) AS alarmTypeDict from (select ky_category.name,camera_manager.id from (camera_manager left join algorithm_manager on camera_manager.id = algorithm_manager.belong_to) left join ky_category on ky_category.id = algorithm_manager.model_name and algorithm_manager.is_rotate=1 ORDER BY ky_category.name) as t WHERE t.id = #{cameraId}

SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.name) AS alarmTypeDict from (select ky_category.name,camera_manager.id from (camera_manager left join algorithm_manager on camera_manager.id = algorithm_manager.belong_to) left join ky_category on ky_category.id = algorithm_manager.model_name ORDER BY ky_category.name) as t WHERE t.id = #{cameraId}

SELECT alarm_detail.camera_id,sum(CASE when alarm_detail.alarm_level = '4' then 1 else 0 end) as seriousCount, count(*) as allCount FROM alarm_detail inner join alarm_audit WHERE alarm_detail.id = alarm_audit.alarm_id and alarm_audit.audit_status = '0' GROUP BY alarm_detail.camera_id
